legend: A robot with the code name MAGD has type n$$$n$$$. To recharge, it requires a device with power p$$$p$$$, satisfying the conditions:
p≥n+1$$$ p \ge n + 1 $$$ (otherwise, the robot will not have enough power to recharge)
p≤n+k$$$ p \le n + k $$$ (otherwise, the robot may burn out)

Among all suitable powers p$$$p$$$, we need to choose the one for which LCM(n$$$n$$$, p$$$p$$$) is minimized, so that the robot's battery lasts as long as possible. Given n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$, we need to compute p$$$p$$$.
LCM(a$$$a$$$,b$$$b$$$) is the least common multiple of the numbers a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$, that is, the smallest natural number that is divisible by both a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$.
